discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its physiological actions, enabling GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has had a huge clinical and societal impact through semaglutide and related drugs. Habener, Mojsov and Drucker received the 2024 Lasker-DeBakey Clinical Award and the Breakthrough Prize, which are strong predictors of a Nobel. The 2025 prize went to immunology (regulatory T cells), so a turn to metabolic physiology is plausible.
